message:
Now I understand the crash. The issue is in `Compile_If`:
1. It calls `CompileBlock` for the `if` block
2. If `o->previousOpcode == c_waOp_else`, it calls `CompileElseBlock`
3. `CompileElseBlock` calls `AcquireCompilationCodePage` which calls `AcquireCodePageWithCapacity`

The MSAN "UNKNOWN READ" at `AcquireCodePageWithCapacity` suggests an uninitialized memory read. Let me look at `RemoveCodePageOfCapacity` and `NewCodePage`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "RemoveCodePageOfCapacity\|NewCodePage\|Environment_AcquireCodePage" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/wasm3/source/m3_env.c | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
